title: The secrets to a healthy old age
speaker: BBC Learning English

keywords.def: (idiom) think and behave in a youthful way, in spite of your age
feeling hopeful, confident and focused on the good aspects of life rather than the bad ones
scientific research using sets of twins to investigate the roles of genetics and environment in human development
food typically eaten by people living around the Mediterranean Sea, such as fresh vegetables, olive oil and fish
occasion when people sit down together to eat, talk and share a meal
people from two or more generations of the same family living in a house together

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: This is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 这里是BBC英语教学的6分钟英语节目。

sentences.en: I’m Phil. And I’m Beth. Grey hairs, wrinkles, and poor eyesight are common signs that our body is growing old.
sentences.zh: 我是Phil。我是Beth。白发、皱纹和视力下降是我们身体变老的常见迹象。

sentences.en: Much as we’d like to, we can’t avoid ageing, so it’s important to stay healthy as we get older.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们很想避免，但衰老是无法避免的，所以随着年龄增长保持健康很重要。

sentences.en: In this programme, we’ll be hearing about some new research offering fresh advice on how to stay young at heart, an idiom meaning to keep a youthful outlook on life, whatever your age.
sentences.zh: 在这个节目中，我们将听到一些新的研究，它们为如何保持心态年轻（young at heart）——一个无论你多大年龄都保持对生活年轻看法的习语——提供了新鲜的建议。

sentences.en: And, of course, we’ll be learning some useful new vocabulary as well.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们也会学到一些有用的新词汇。

sentences.en: But 6 Minute English isn’t just about vocabulary – we improve your listening skills as well, so why not turn on the audio subtitles or download the script to read along as you listen?
sentences.zh: 但6分钟英语不只是关于词汇——我们还能提高你的听力技能，所以为什么不开启音频字幕或下载文稿一边听一边读呢？

sentences.en: It could also help you answer my question.
sentences.zh: 这或许也能帮你回答我的问题。

sentences.en: The oldest recorded person ever to have lived was a woman who was born in 1875, and lived to the ripe old age of 122.
sentences.zh: 有记录以来最长寿的人是一位生于1875年的女性，她活到了122岁的高龄。

sentences.en: But which country was she from? Was it: a) Japan b) France or, c) Italy?
sentences.zh: 但她来自哪个国家？是：a) 日本 b) 法国 还是 c) 意大利？

sentences.en: I am going to say Japan. OK, Beth, I’ll reveal the correct answer later in the programme.
sentences.zh: 我猜是日本。好的，Beth，我会在节目晚些时候公布正确答案。

sentences.en: Ageing is partly caused by the body’s cells starting to decay, so you might think we’re powerless to stop it.
sentences.zh: 衰老部分是由身体细胞开始衰退引起的，所以你可能会认为我们对此无能为力。

sentences.en: But listen to this good news from Professor Sarah Harper, Director of the Oxford Institute of Population Ageing: I think the really exciting thing is that even 10 years ago we would have thought: Yes, it's all to do with our cells.
sentences.zh: 但请听牛津大学人口老龄化研究所所长Sarah Harper教授带来的好消息：我认为真正令人兴奋的是，即使在10年前，我们也会认为：是的，这全都是由我们的细胞决定的。

sentences.en: Now we understand this relationship between what we call ‘cell and society’, and we really can make a difference!
sentences.zh: 现在我们理解了所谓的‘细胞与社会’之间的这种关系，我们真的可以带来改变！

sentences.en: And in fact, a recent paper just came out which said that 60% of our ageing can be controlled by how we live.
sentences.zh: 事实上，最近刚发表的一篇论文指出，我们60%的衰老是可以由我们的生活方式来控制的。

sentences.en: Professor Harper says that 60% of ageing is determined by something we can influence, our lifestyle.
sentences.zh: Harper教授表示，60%的衰老是由我们可以影响的因素——我们的生活方式决定的。

sentences.en: So, what lifestyle should we choose? Here’s Sarah Harper giving more details to BBC Radio 4 programme, 'Inside Health': You know, there's obviously things like diet, which I think we’ll come to, but there's also a positive attitude,and there's been some wonderful twin studies that have been done where you've had twins and they have been able to map them across their lives, and if you're positive, you actually have far greater health in later life than if you're negative.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们应该选择什么样的生活方式呢？以下是Sarah Harper向BBC Radio 4节目“Inside Health”透露的更多细节：你知道，显然有一些事情比如饮食，我想我们等下会讲到，但也有积极的心态，并且已经有一些很棒的双胞胎研究，他们研究了一对对双胞胎并追踪了他们的一生，如果你心态积极，你晚年的健康状况实际上要比心态消极的人好得多。

sentences.en: One important factor in ageing well is a positive attitude - feeling hopeful, confident, and focused on the good things in life.
sentences.zh: 健康衰老的一个重要因素是积极的心态——感到充满希望、自信并专注于生活中的美好事物。

sentences.en: This conclusion was based on several twin studies, scientific research which uses twins to study the roles of genetics and environment in human development.
sentences.zh: 这一结论基于多项双胞胎研究，这是一种利用双胞胎来研究遗传和环境在人类发展中作用的科学研究。

sentences.en: In studies, Professor Harper found positive twins stayed healthier than negative twins as they aged.
sentences.zh: 在研究中，Harper教授发现，心态积极的双胞胎在变老时比心态消极的双胞胎保持得更健康。

sentences.en: Loneliness can be another problem as we get older.
sentences.zh: 随着年龄增长，孤独可能是另一个问题。

sentences.en: Here, Professor Sarah Harper explains how in countries like Spain, Italy and Greece, regular social interaction helps people age well: Loneliness can have the same impact as smoking in the statistics.
sentences.zh: 在这里，Sarah Harper教授解释了在西班牙、意大利和希腊等国家，常规的社交互动如何帮助人们健康衰老：在统计数据中，孤独可以产生与吸烟相同的影响。

sentences.en: And when we talked about the Mediterranean diet, it's also got two other sides: it's got exercise because these people tend to be outside more because they have that kind of a climate, but also they still tend to live [communal meals]…
sentences.zh: 当我们谈到地中海饮食时，它还有另外两个方面：它有运动，因为这些人往往在户外呆得更多，因为他们有那种气候，而且他们也倾向于过着[集体用餐]的生活……

sentences.en: Absolutely they have communal meals, they tend to live together more in multigenerational households, that is changing a bit, so there's a whole lifestyle around it.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们一起吃集体饭菜，他们往往更多地一起生活在多代同堂的家庭中，这确实有点改变了，所以围绕它有一整套生活方式。

sentences.en: The healthy food, such as fresh vegetables and fish, eaten by people living in countries around the Mediterranean Sea, is known as the Mediterranean diet.
sentences.zh: 地中海沿岸国家的人们所吃的健康食物，如新鲜蔬菜和鱼类，被称为地中海饮食。

sentences.en: Mediterranean cultures have other advantages too, including outdoor exercise, which is easier in warm climates, and communal meals, occasions when people sit down and share food together.
sentences.zh: 地中海文化还有其他优势，包括户外运动（在温暖气候下更容易进行）以及集体用餐（人们坐在一起分享食物的场合）。

sentences.en: Mediterranean people are also more likely to live in multigenerational households, where people from two or more generations of a family live together in the same house.
sentences.zh: 地中海地区的人们也更有可能生活在多代同堂的家庭中，即一个家庭中两代或更多代人住在同一所房子里。

sentences.en: Not everyone can live in the Mediterranean, but it seems a positive attitude and social interaction are two things we can all do to age well.
sentences.zh: 不是每个人都能住在地中海，但积极的心态和社交互动似乎是我们所有人都能做到以健康衰老的两件事。

sentences.en: Speaking of which, what was the answer to your question, Phil?
sentences.zh: 说到这，你问题的答案是什么，Phil？

sentences.en: OK, well, I asked you about the oldest living person ever recorded.
sentences.zh: 好的，嗯，我问了你关于有记录以来最长寿的人的事。

sentences.en: I asked what country they came from, and you said Japan.
sentences.zh: 我问他们来自哪个国家，你说是日本。

sentences.en: Well, I can reveal the answer is actually France.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我可以揭晓答案其实是法国。

sentences.en: A lady in France lived for 122 years and 164 days.
sentences.zh: 法国的一位女士活到了122岁零164天。

sentences.en: And if you knew the answer to that, there are other questions about this programme in the quiz on our worksheet, which you can find on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 如果你知道这个问题的答案，我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com上的练习表里还有关于这个节目的其他测验问题。

sentences.en: OK, let’s recap the new vocabulary we’ve learned about staying young at heart, an idiom which means to think and behave in a youthful way, in spite of growing older.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们回顾一下我们学到的关于保持心态年轻（young at heart）的新词汇，这个习语的意思是尽管变老，但思想和行为依然年轻。

sentences.en: People with a positive attitude feel hopeful, confident, and focused on the good things in life.
sentences.zh: 心态积极的人感到充满希望、自信，并专注于生活中的美好事物。

sentences.en: Twin studies use twins to investigate the roles of genetics and environment in human development.
sentences.zh: 双胞胎研究利用双胞胎来调查遗传和环境在人类发展中的作用。

sentences.en: A Mediterranean diet describes the foods typically eaten by people living in countries around the Mediterranean Sea, including fresh vegetables, olive oil and fish.
sentences.zh: 地中海饮食描述了生活在地中海沿岸国家的人们通常食用的食物，包括新鲜蔬菜、橄榄油和鱼类。

sentences.en: At a communal meal, people sit down together to talk and share food.
sentences.zh: 在集体用餐时，人们坐在一起聊天并分享食物。

sentences.en: And finally, a multigenerational household is when people from two or more generations of the same family live together.
sentences.zh: 最后，多代同堂家庭是指同一个家庭的两代或更多代人生活在一起。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up, but if you enjoyed this discussion then head over to the BBC Learning English website to find the accompanying worksheet and quiz, along with loads of other programmes and resources to help learn English.
sentences.zh: 我们的6分钟时间又到了，但如果你喜欢这次讨论，请前往BBC Learning English网站寻找配套的练习表和测验，还有大量其他节目和资源来帮助学习英语。

sentences.en: See you there! Bye!
sentences.zh: 在那儿见！再见！
